title: A good first experience in Morocco when time is limited.
text: What impressed me most about this experience was the willingness of both guides to tailor the experience to our interests. Both Luis in Spain and Nasser in Morocco were communicative and passionate about their countries. That being said, the experience would be improved by your expressing in advance what you want to get from the day or letting them know what interests you. title: This was a true highlight...
text: This was a true highlight of our 10 day trip in Spain and Portugal. It is a well orchestrated day to maximize the experience, with local guides meeting you at each place. We enjoyed the monkeys in Gibraltar (esp seeing  them early before crowds), riding the camels on the beach, and the delicious Moroccan lunch. It was a very full but wonderful day!
author: Kristin

title: Amazing!
text: Wow! Such an amazing day. 6:00 pick up by Ry and we drove to Tarifa, boarded the ferry and went to Tanger. Omar was there waiting for us and took us on a 4 hour tour of Tanger including camel ride on the beach, the Medina, Kabash, and an amazing lunch. Then boarded back on the ferry and picked up by Ry and drove to Gibraltar where we once again crossed the boarder, were picked up by our guide got a tour of the rock including close up time with the monkeys. title: Amazing day!!
text:
We did this private tour from Seville to Gibraltar, then to Tarifa and from there by boat to Tangier, and it was an amazing experience. The views throughout the tour were breathtaking and very varied.

The guide was close, attentive and always attentive to us, which made everything easy and very pleasant. Being a private tour, it felt very exclusive, unhurried and fully adapted to our pace.

The drive to Gibraltar was very comfortable and conveyed a lot of tranquility, which allowed us to enjoy the road with total confidence from the first moment.

A very well organized and highly recommended
